title: Sharp and Stable Label-Free Calibration Certificates from Logical Coherence
abstract: arXiv:2610.21567v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Query-conditioned probabilistic predictors answer logically related questions one at a time, and labels to check their calibration are often missing. For each restriction on what a bettor's stakes may use, a minimax theorem identifies, for finitely supported laws of the answers, the sharp label-free lower bound on the corresponding calibration residual. On bundles of different events its mean, marginal and joint stages can separate strictly, and a bundle's bound cannot be attributed to one question without assumptions on the others. The sharp marginal bound is discontinuous in the answers, and no label-free lower bound continuous in the Wasserstein distance stays within a constant factor of it. Lipschitz stakes give a stable bound, sharp for a smooth calibration residual and, for every positive Lipschitz constant, positive exactly when the sharp marginal bound is. On i.i.d. streams, projected online gradient ascent at fixed nodes gives f

translated_title: 基于逻辑一致性的锐利且稳定的无标签校准证书
translated_abstract: 以查询为条件的概率预测器每次回答一个逻辑相关的问题，而用于检验其校准性的标签常常缺失。针对对赌注者可使用的赌注信息的每一种限制，一个极小极大定理在答案具有有限支撑分布的条件下，确定了相应校准残差的锐利无标签下界。在不同事件的捆绑上，其均值、边缘与联合阶段可以严格分离，并且在不对其他问题作假设的前提下，一个捆绑的下界不能归因于某个单一问题。锐利的边缘下界关于答案是不连续的，且在Wasserstein距离下连续的任何无标签下界都无法保持在其常数倍以内。Lipschitz赌注给出一个稳定的下界，它对光滑的校准残差是锐利的，并且对每个正的Lipschitz常数，它为正当且仅当锐利边缘下界为正。在独立同分布的数据流上，在固定节点处进行投影在线梯度上升可以（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文利用极小极大定理从逻辑一致性出发，为查询条件概率预测器建立了锐利且稳定的无标签校准残差下界证书，并证明Lipschitz赌注形式既稳定又可通过在线梯度上升在独立同分布数据流上有效优化。
en_tdlr: This paper uses minimax theorems grounded in logical coherence to derive sharp and stable label-free lower bounds on calibration residuals for query-conditioned probabilistic predictors, showing that Lipschitz stakes yield stable, sharp bounds that can be optimized via projected online gradient ascent on i.i.d. streams.
